name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Conflict of Interest
source:
This game takes place a year and a half after the events of Apollo Justice (consider it an alternate universe from AA:DD). Phoenix has retaken the bar exam and gotten his attorney's badge back. He finds himself involved with a series of cases, all apparently connected to each other and all somehow tying back to his new prosecutor rival, Obadiah Williamson. Can Nick unmask this conspiracy of lies, forgery, and betrayal? Or will he too become corrupted by it?

This game contains a few spoilers for Apollo Justice and Trials and Tribulations.

[Taken from [URL=http://forums.court-records.net/viewtopic.php?f=36&t=20194]official website[/URL].]
translation:
这场比赛发生在阿波罗正义事件一年半后（将其视为AA:DD的平行宇宙）。菲尼克斯重新参加了律师考试并拿回了律师证。他发现自己卷入了一系列案件，所有案件显然都相互关联，而且都以某种方式与他的新检察官对手奥巴迪亚·威廉姆森联系在一起。尼克能否揭开这个由谎言、伪造和背叛组成的阴谋？或者他也会因此而堕落吗？

本游戏包含《阿波罗正义》和《审判与磨难》的一些剧透。

[摘自[URL=http://forums.court-records.net/viewtopic.php?f=36&t=20194]官方网站[/URL].]
